verdicts.reason: A is basically the original shrunk and centred. The composition is intact and readable, but the background doesn't fill the canvas: there are grey pillarbox bands on both sides with a visible edge, and the skyline stops short of the canvas edges. B tears the design apart. The red quote panel is jammed against the top-right edge, the white frame has turned into an empty grey box on the left that holds only stray decorative lines, and the skyline floats on its own under the quote. The layering and unity of the original are lost.
